source_row.rationale: Dental plaque can contain pathogenic bacteria, and plaque rapidly reforms without mechanical oral hygiene. Regular toothbrushing helps reduce plaque and oral bacterial burden. Oral care is part of pneumonia-prevention practice, but it does not replace suctioning or other ventilator-care measures.
source_row.source_detail: Oral-care background: dental plaque rapidly reforms and can harbor pathogenic bacteria; toothbrushing reduces plaque burden; published 2024-03-27; accessed 2026-08-14.

source_row.stem: A mechanically ventilated client receives regular oral care that includes toothbrushing. Why is toothbrushing clinically relevant even though the client is not eating by mouth?
